experiment: 5-fold person-grouped CV, forward Mamba with a read-out per slice, 20 s slices

input.normalisation: per slice and signal (slice average - video average) / video spread (mamba_10s_slices.slice_levels(x, 20)), then z-scored with the fold's training videos and cut at +-4

epochs_rule: lowest inner-CV held-out loss (inner person-grouped 5-fold CV over the fold's training people, seeds averaged)

training.final: every seed trained on all of the fold's training videos for the chosen epochs; test logits averaged

reference: ridge of ridge_5s_model.fit on the same folds
